title: Starmer replacement remains to be found as pressure for PM to resign grows
summary: A second junior minister resigned from embattled UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer's government on May 12 as a growing number of lawmakers from his Labour party urged him to quit. But as the pressure grows, no potential replacement to Starmer has risen so far - although some candidates have been drawn out. FRANCE 24's Angela Diffley tells us the latest, and wh…
